doNotInfer: The eight-primitive coverage test is exactly the shape that goes vacuous — five guards in this wave have already passed while inspecting nothing. Print the primitives it actually resolved and their count, then orphan one on purpose and watch the test go RED before calling it done. Report both.
resolveRunSurfaceMotion rejects a call without a real trigger by construction. Do NOT weaken it to make a consumer fit. Never drive a reveal from a timer.
This issue adds no second clock. Replay pacing belongs to use-replay-events.ts and stays there.

The caret contrast must be ASSERTED against both panel fills, not reasoned from the token's 5.80:1 on white — the caret is the one live-edge element sitting directly on a panel fill rather than being a filled swatch.
If 60% dim cannot clear 4.5:1, do not ship unreadable cards and do not silently rewrite the spec. Reduce to the smallest clearing value and record the deviation in the diff.
Use color-mix, never rgba(). #1912's token-only-theming test fails on a literal colour, blur or shadow in any rule added here.
Do NOT edit packages/theme/run-surface-tokens.css. juli-run-streaming-caret is already defined there and named in tokens.ts; this issue applies it, it does not redefine it.
Pin PYTHONPATH="$PWD/backend/src:$PWD" for any pytest run inside the worktree, or the green is fake.
